title: AI classifies nasopharyngeal narrow-band images and improves reader agreement
summary: A segmentation and five-class Ni classification system was trained on 5404 retrospectively collected NBI images. In two external cohorts accuracy was 0.889 and 0.873 (AUC 0.976 and 0.967), and in recorded video 0.888 (AUC 0.974). In a randomized crossover reader study with 12 physicians and 200 images, AI assistance raised Fleiss kappa from 0.610 to 0.788 for juniors and from 0.744 to 0.870 for seniors, and reduced potentially unnecessary biopsy decisions.
ai_technology: Deep-learning lesion segmentation and five-class Ni classification networks
organization: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College; Cancer Hospital of Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

evidence.tested: Two external cohorts, recorded videos and a reader study on images.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective images; reader study not a clinical outcome trial; full text not reviewed.
